I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM.

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk for the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched the SMS routing that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through without anyone stepping in.

2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Also logged by Thea. The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, and the ticket went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The sheet has no date, so I can't say when it was raised.

Things to watch for in the weekly notes:
- These are two different tickets with similar numbers, and both involve Door 14, so keep them apart.
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central handoffs digest belong to the Central team's Marrow accounts, not QFL.
- Moss's other two notes that mention QFL (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) don't have ticket numbers.
- The cheat sheet says Quarendon Freightways is a separate company and not our customer, so don't mix the two up.
- Moss's notes don't say whether either ticket is closed now. Check the ticket system before you call them resolved.

I checked all six Moss notes on the share. Moss has no notes folder of his own, and #general and #help-it-ops had no messages.
